address: 14 rue de la Banque, Paris, 75002, France
bio: Originally from Beirut, Liza Asseily gives pride of place to the food of her homeland. In a bright interior strewn with Middle Eastern touches, you can expect mezze to share, grilled meats or fattet batinjan (aubergine, minced lamb and yoghurt). Numerous vegetarian dishes and a fine selection of Lebanese wines....
